title: Chris Hani Road Closed — Taxi Accident
description: Chris Hani Road between Old Potchefstroom Road and Klipspruit Valley Road is closed due to a taxi accident. Emergency services on scene. Use N12 or Soweto Highway as alternative.

title: Heavy Traffic on Soweto Highway
